english.title: Operator fail to comply with requirements imposed by Article 3 of the Community Regulation 273/2004

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: requirements for placing on the market of scheduled substances

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an operator, failed to comply with a requirement, namely **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT..), imposed by Article 3 of Regulation (EC) No 273/2004 relating to the requirement for placing on the market of scheduled substances
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation7 of the Controlled Drugs (Drug Precursors) (Intra-Community Trade)Regulations 2008.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Regulation 7(2) of the Controlled Drugs (Drug Precursors)(Intra-Community Trade) Regulations 2008 provides that the reference in paragraph (1) to a person who fails to comply with any of the requirements imposed by Article 3 of the Community Regulation includes a person, who in purported compliance with any such provision (a) furnishes information which he knows to be false in a material particular; or (b) recklessly furnishes information which is false in a material particular.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.
